When a buyer asks us for a bridge concre.zh: 客户问我们要桥梁混凝土泵时，邢台工程师不会先问工程名称，而会先问这次浇筑能不能连续进行。墩柱、承台和桥面板都是体量活。料斗一旦空了，管路可能中断，混凝土会在管里变稠。疏通堵管不是浇筑。连续供料是工地条件，我们用目录输送量去对照，而不是当口号。
When a buyer asks us for a bridge concre.pt: When a buyer asks us for a bridge concrete pump, our engineers in Xingtai do not start from a project name. We start from whether the pour can stay continuous. Pier shafts, pile caps and deck slabs are volume jobs. If the hopper runs empty, the pipeline can stall and the mix can stiffen in the line. Recovering a blocked pipe is not placement. Continuous feed is a site requirement we match against catalogue output, not a slogan.

A trailer pump only delivers what arrive.zh: 拖泵只输送到达料斗的混凝土。搅拌车、搅拌计划和管路布置，才决定目录上的 30 m³/h 或 95 m³/h 在浇筑点能不能成立。不少公路和跨河工地也没有稳定三相电，所以基建混凝土泵我们先翻柴油拖泵。这些管道泵在邢台任泽工业园区制造。我们不销售车载臂架泵。
A trailer pump only delivers what arrive.pt: A bomba reboque only delivers what arrives at the hopper. Mixer trucks, the batching plan and the pipeline layout decide whether a listed 30 m³/h or 95 m³/h can exist at the pour point. Many highway and river sites also lack stable trifásico power, which is why diesel bomba reboques are the models we open for infrastructure concrete pump discussions. We manufacture those line pumps in Xingtai, at Renze Industrial Park. We do not sell truck-mounted bomba lanças.
A trailer pump only delivers what arrive.ar: A مضخة مقطورة only delivers what arrives at the hopper. Mixer trucks, the batching plan and the pipeline layout decide whether a listed 30 m³/h or 95 m³/h can exist at the pour point. Many highway and river sites also lack stable ثلاثي الطور power, which is why diesel مضخة مقطورةs are the models we open for infrastructure concrete pump discussions. We manufacture those line pumps in شينغتاي, at Renze Industrial Park. We do not sell truck-mounted مضخة ذراعs.

Treat 30 m³/h as theoretical. For a pier.zh: 30 m³/h 按理论值看待。墩柱必须在一个窗口内浇完时，我们会问搅拌车能不能把 0.4 m³ 料斗持续喂满。30 MPa 是目录出口压力，不是弯头很多的桥面管一定能跑到 30 MPa。计划速率低于 30 m³/h、管路落在目录距离内，柴油50是起点。同一窗口需要更大排量时，我们改对柴油60或LZ-80，而不会给柴油50发明额外能力。
Treat 30 m³/h as theoretical. For a pier.pt: Treat 30 m³/h as theoretical. For a pier that must stay in one window, we ask whether mixer trucks can keep that 0.4 m³ hopper moving. 30 MPa is listed pressão de saída, not a promise that a bent deck line will run at 30 MPa. If the planned rate sits under 30 m³/h and the line stays inside the listed distance, Diesel 50 is the starting match. If the same window needs more volume, we step to Diesel 60 or LZ-80 rather than inventing extra capacity on Diesel 50.

We point to Diesel 60 when the crew need.zh: 当现场需要更高理论供料、减少搅拌车等泵，或买家要更大功率的 6105 柴油机方案时，我们指向柴油60。两台机料斗都是 0.4 m³，连续供料仍取决于搅拌车到场，而不是更大料斗。若浇筑明显是大排量或粗骨料工况，我们接着打开 LZ-80，而不是把柴油60拉伸到目录 35 m³/h 以外。
We point to Diesel 60 when the crew need.pt: We point to Diesel 60 when the crew needs a higher theoretical feed so trucks wait less on the pump, or when the buyer wants the higher-power 6105 package on a diesel infrastructure site. The hopper is still 0.4 m³ on both machines, so continuous feed still depends on truck arrival, not on a larger hopper. If the pour is clearly a high-volume or coarse-agregado job, we open LZ-80 next instead of stretching Diesel 60 past its listed 35 m³/h.

Some pier and deck jobs are volume probl.zh: 有些墩柱和桥面不是 30–35 m³/h 的问题，而是体量问题：厚桥面、大承台，或更粗的骨料。LZ-80 是我们在这一档列出的大排量柴油拖泵。目录：玉柴 256 kW；高压输送量 ≤65 m³/h / 低压输送量 ≤95 m³/h；高压 ≤35 MPa / 低压 ≤22 MPa；料斗 0.6 m³；输送距离 120 m；骨料 ≤6 cm；川崎双 140；外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m；整机 6800 kg。
Some pier and deck jobs are volume probl.pt: Some pier and deck jobs are volume problems, not 30–35 m³/h problems: thick decks, large pile caps, or coarser agregado. LZ-80 is the high-capacity diesel bomba reboque we list in that band. High-pressure and low-pressure modes are.zh: 高压与低压是两档已公布工况。更高的目录输送量对应更低的目录压力；更高的目录压力对应更低的目录输送量。管路真正需要哪一档，问清楚之前，不要把 95 m³/h 直接说成桥面浇筑量。0.6 m³ 料斗比柴油50/60 大，只有搅拌侧跟得上才有意义。骨料最大 6 cm 是目录上限。输送距离列 120 m，短于柴油50和柴油60的水平 150 m，所以 LZ-80 是排量机型，不是自动的长距离机型。
High-pressure and low-pressure modes are.pt: High-pressure and low-pressure modes are two listed operating bands: higher listed output sits with lower listed pressure. We ask which band the pipeline needs before anyone quotes 95 m³/h on a deck. The 0.6 m³ hopper only helps if the batching side can fill it. Aggregate up to 6 cm is a catalogue maximum. Conveying distance is 120 m — shorter than the 150 m horizontal figures on Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 — so LZ-80 is a volume machine, not an automatic long-line machine.

Wash is not optional. Set concrete in th.zh: 冲洗不是可选项。凝固在 S 管、料斗或变径里的混凝土不是易损件，是自己造成的堵塞。机组允许时先反泵几下卸压。冲洗料斗和格栅，直到出水不再带灰浆。管路清管直到出口干净。打开并冲洗 S 管区域，不要让切削副留在一层水泥皮里。
Wash is not optional. Set concrete in th.pt: Wash is not optional. Set concrete in the tubo S, hopper, or a reducer is a blockage you made, not a wear part. Reverse a few strokes if the unit allows. Wash hopper and grate until water runs clear. Clean the pipeline until discharge is clear. Rinse the tubo S so the cutting pair is not left in a cement skin.
Wash is not optional. Set concrete in th.ar: Wash is not optional. Set concrete in the أنبوب S, hopper, or a reducer is a blockage you made, not a wear part. Reverse a few strokes if the unit allows. The Electric 20 is a 22 kW electric trai.zh: 电动20型是22 kW电动拖泵。目录输送量8–10 m³/h，出口压力10 MPa，料斗0.25 m³，水平120 m / 垂直40 m，整机900 kg。输送管内径80 mm，最大骨料粒径1–2 cm。这组数字要一起读：管子不是单独卖的“更粗一档”，而是跟这台22 kW、细骨料工况写在同一张参数表上的。
The Electric 20 is a 22 kW electric trai.pt: The Electric 20 is a 22 kW electric bomba reboque: 8–10 m³/h at 10 MPa, 0.25 m³ hopper, 120 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, 900 kg. Tubo de entrega is 80 mm. Maximum agregado is 1–2 cm.
The Electric 20 is a 22 kW electric trai.ar: The Electric 20 is a 22 kW electric مضخة مقطورة: 8–10 m³/h at 10 MPa, 0.25 m³ hopper, 120 m أفقي / 40 m عمودي, 900 kg. أنبوب النقل is 80 mm. Maximum ركام is 1–2 cm.
The Electric 20 is a 22 kW electric trai.ru: The Electric 20 is a 22 kW electric прицепной насос: 8–10 m³/h at 10 MPa, 0.25 m³ hopper, 120 m горизонталь / 40 m вертикаль, 900 kg. Бетоновод is 80 mm. Maximum заполнитель is 1–2 cm.

That 80 mm figure is why we interrupt a.zh: 正是这个80 mm，让我们会打断“先报价”的询盘。电动20并不是“功率更大管子就该更粗”的机型。它公布的管路是80 mm，并且配的是相对细的骨料区间。如果现场拌合物经常超过1–2 cm，就不该在这台泵上谈管子——我们应该去看目录管径写成100 / 125 mm的机型。很多询盘把电动20当成“比15更大的管子”，邢台车间的对照结果正好相反。
That 80 mm figure is why we interrupt a.pt: That 80 mm figure is why we interrupt a price-first enquiry. The Electric 20 is not a bigger-pipe machine just because it has more kilowatts than Electric 15. If your mix regularly sits above 1–2 cm, look at models whose catalogue pipe is 100 / 125 mm.

Three-phase power is common on city jobs.zh: 城市工地常见三相电。河北农村宅基地、进山路、只有单相农用电的地块，并不保证有三相。电动泵在整个浇筑窗口都需要这份电源。线没接到、容量不够、或和其他设备抢电跳闸，泵就开不了。三相电到位之前买电动泵，等于把浇筑日押在供电进度上，这是我们不建议的。
Three-phase power is common on city jobs.pt: Three-phase power is common on city jobs. If the cable is missing, undersized, or shared with other plant that trips the breaker, the pump does not run.

A two- or three-floor house is the first.pt: A two- or three-floor house is the first question we hear. About 3 m per floor puts three floors near 9 m of rise before bends. Electric 15 lists 15–20 m vertical, so height alone often fits this small building concrete pump. The usual limit is extra horizontal metres plus elbows. Stay inside 60–80 m horizontal. If the hose will snake around the yard, measure it.

Secondary structure is the second fit: s.zh: 二次结构是第二类对口工况：室内楼梯、圈梁、小柱、填充浇筑，管路短、石子仍在1–3 cm。电动15型公布的100–125 mm管，就是这条配合比下我们列出的管径。询盘里我们仍要塌落度和石子粒径，因为表上上限3 cm的石子，和细石灌浆不是一回事；二次结构若改用更细的料，也请写明，便于对照10系列已列的2 cm及以下骨料。这台泵不是喷涂机，抹灰喷涂请到 /products/spraying-machines。

The listed 100–125 mm pipe is what we publish for that mix. We still ask for slump and stone size, because 3 cm stone is not the same as pedra fina grout. This pump is not a spraying machine; plaster work belongs on /products/spraying-machines.

When buyers write to us at Hebei Pinjin.pt: When buyers write to us at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, they rarely ask whether we make a concrete pump. They ask whether to take the Electric 20 or the Electric 30. Both are electric bomba reboques from the same catalogue. They sit on neighbouring bays in our Renze Industrial Park workshop. The difference is hopper volume, pressão de saída, output, published conveying distance, pipe diameter where we list it, agregado size, and weight.

On the shop floor the hopper is the firs.pt: On the shop floor the hopper is the first thing you see between the two frames. The Electric 20 lists 0.25 m³. The Electric 30 lists 0.3 m³. That 0.05 m³ is the catalogue line we weld and fit to. A larger hopper gives the mixer truck a slightly larger buffer before the pumping cylinders take the mix. It does not replace output in m³/h, and it does not replace pressão de saída.

We tell buyers not to treat hopper volum.pt: We tell buyers not to treat hopper volume as how much the pump can place in an hour. Output is a separate line: 8–10 m³/h on the 20, 12–15 m³/h on the 30. When a contractor writes to us in Xingta.zh: 承包商写信到邢台，说要一台“20层”用的高层混凝土泵时，我们的工程师不会先报型号。我们先把建筑换成垂直泵送高度。层高按约 3 m 做案头换算：20 层 × 约 3 m ≈ 60 m 垂直高度。裙房、转换层和地下室坡道都会改这个数字，所以我们仍会问估算层高，而不是把“20层”当成技术参数。这一步是在任泽工业园区把采购语言改成目录语言：目录只公布米，不公布“层”。
When a contractor writes to us in Xingta.pt: When a contractor writes to us in Xingtai and asks for a high rise concrete pump for “20 floors”, our engineers do not start with a model name. We convert the building into a vertical pumping height. A storey-to-storey height around 3 m is a planning figure we use on the desk: 20 floors × about 3 m ≈ 60 m of rise. Podium decks, transfer floors and porão ramps change that number, so we still ask for the estimated floor-to-floor height rather than treating “20 floors” as a specification.
When a contractor writes to us in Xingta.ar: When a contractor writes to us in شينغتاي and asks for a high rise concrete pump for “20 floors”, our engineers do not start with a model name. We convert the building into a عمودي pumping height. A storey-to-storey height around 3 m is a planning figure we use on the desk: 20 floors × about 3 m ≈ 60 m of rise. Podium decks, transfer floors and قبو ramps change that number, so we still ask for the estimated floor-to-floor height rather than treating “20 floors” as a specification.
When a contractor writes to us in Xingta.ru: When a contractor writes to us in Синтай and asks for a high rise concrete pump for “20 floors”, our engineers do not start with a model name. We convert the building into a вертикаль pumping height. A storey-to-storey height around 3 m is a planning figure we use on the desk: 20 floors × about 3 m ≈ 60 m of rise. Podium decks, transfer floors and подвал ramps change that number, so we still ask for the estimated floor-to-floor height rather than treating “20 floors” as a specification.

That 60 m figure is only the riser. Cata.zh: 这 60 m 只是立管高度。目录表把垂直泵送高度和水平距离分成两列公布。把拖式泵对上建筑，要按实际要打的料——细石、13 mm 石子或约 2 cm 骨料——去读这两列，而不是对着图纸标题栏上的层数。细石行和 13 mm 行不是同一组余量，混用两列会把可打高度看宽。
That 60 m figure is only the riser. Cata.pt: That 60 m figure is only the riser. Catalogue tables list a vertical pumping height and a horizontal distance as separate published numbers. Matching a bomba reboque to a building means reading both columns against the mix you will actually pump — pedra fina, 13 mm stone or about 2 cm agregado — not against a floor count on a drawing title block.
That 60 m figure is only the riser. Cata.ar: That 60 m figure is only the riser. Catalogue tables list a عمودي pumping height and a أفقي distance as separate published numbers. Matching a مضخة مقطورة to a building means reading both columns against the mix you will actually pump — حصى ناعم, 13 mm stone or about 2 cm ركام — not against a floor count on a drawing title block.
That 60 m figure is only the riser. Cata.ru: That 60 m figure is only the riser. Catalogue tables list a вертикаль pumping height and a горизонталь distance as separate published numbers. Matching a прицепной насос to a building means reading both columns against the mix you will actually pump — мелкий камень, 13 mm stone or about 2 cm заполнитель — not against a floor count on a drawing title block.

On a typical building plot the pump stan.zh: 常见工地里，泵停在地面。输送管先水平接到核心筒，再垂直上去，再在作业层水平铺开。地面管和楼面管的每一米都算工况。目录没有印发“当量长度”换算式，我们不会另编一套，也不把弯头折算成未公布的等效米数。我们会问计划的地面管长、已经知道的 90° 弯头数量和骨料粒径，再把这些事实放到目录水平/垂直两列旁边对照。
On a typical building plot the pump stan.pt: On a typical building plot the pump stands at ground level. Tubo de entrega runs horizontally to the core, then vertically, then horizontally again across the working floor. Every metre of that ground line and deck line is part of the job. We não invente an “equivalent length” formula that não está impresso in the catalogue. We ask for the planned ground-pipe length, the number of 90° bends you already know about, and the agregado size, then we sit those facts next to the listed H / V columns.
On a typical building plot the pump stan.ar: On a typical building plot the pump stands at ground level. أنبوب النقل runs أفقيly to the core, then عموديly, then أفقيly again across the working floor. Every metre of that ground line and deck line is part of the job. We لا تختلق an “equivalent length” formula that غير مطبوع in the catalogue. We ask for the planned ground-pipe length, the number of 90° bends you already know about, and the ركام size, then we sit those facts next to the listed H / V columns.
On a typical building plot the pump stan.ru: On a typical building plot the pump stands at ground level. Бетоновод runs горизонтальly to the core, then вертикальly, then горизонтальly again across the working floor. Every metre of that ground line and deck line is part of the job. We не выдумывать an “equivalent length” formula that не напечатано in the catalogue. We ask for the planned ground-pipe length, the number of 90° bends you already know about, and the заполнитель size, then we sit those facts next to the listed H / V columns.

That is why a 20-floor request can still.zh: 所以即使用 60 m 去对比目录垂直泵送高度显得有余量，20 层仍可能对不上电动40：水平余量不够时，料会先消耗在地面管上。把泵位、立管、楼面管画一张简图发给我们。我们更愿意在任泽工业园区读这张简图，而不是去猜我们并不生产的布料杆幅度。高层选型问的是米和管，不是底盘上的臂架半径。
That is why a 20-floor request can still.pt: That is why a 20-floor request can still be the wrong Electric 40 match even when 60 m looks smaller than a listed vertical pumping height. If the remaining horizontal budget is short, the mix will see the ground line first. Send us a simple sketch: pump station, riser, deck run. We would rather read that sketch in Renze Industrial Park than guess a boom radius we do not manufacture.
That is why a 20-floor request can still.ar: That is why a 20-floor request can still be the wrong Electric 40 match even when 60 m looks smaller than a listed عمودي pumping height. If the remaining أفقي budget is short, the mix will see the ground line first. Send us a simple sketch: pump station, riser, deck run. We would rather read that sketch in Renze Industrial Park than guess a boom radius we do not manufacture.
That is why a 20-floor request can still.ru: That is why a 20-floor request can still be the wrong Electric 40 match even when 60 m looks smaller than a listed вертикаль pumping height. If the remaining горизонталь budget is short, the mix will see the ground line first. Send us a simple sketch: pump station, riser, deck run. We would rather read that sketch in Renze Industrial Park than guess a boom radius we do not manufacture.

Planning conversion we use: 20 floors ×.zh: 案头换算：20 层 × 约 3 m ≈ 60 m 垂直，再计入量得到的地面管和楼面管。没有量过地面管时，不要只用层数去对电动40的垂直列。
Planning conversion we use: 20 floors ×.pt: Planning conversion we use: 20 floors × ~3 m ≈ 60 m vertical, then add the ground and deck pipe you can measure.
Planning conversion we use: 20 floors ×.ar: Planning conversion we use: 20 floors × ~3 m ≈ 60 m عمودي, then add the ground and deck pipe you can measure.
Planning conversion we use: 20 floors ×.ru: Planning conversion we use: 20 floors × ~3 m ≈ 60 m вертикаль, then add the ground and deck pipe you can measure.

Catalogue distances are listed by aggreg.zh: 目录距离按骨料分级公布。细石数字不能当成 24 mm 或 2 cm 骨料的数字。电动40、60、80 三张表要读到对应石子那一行再比 60 m 立管。
Catalogue distances are listed by aggreg.pt: Catalogue distances are listed by agregado class. Fine-stone figures are not a 24 mm or 2 cm figure.
Catalogue distances are listed by aggreg.ar: Catalogue distances are listed by ركام class. Fine-stone figures are not a 24 mm or 2 cm figure.
Catalogue distances are listed by aggreg.ru: Catalogue distances are listed by заполнитель class. Fine-stone figures are not a 24 mm or 2 cm figure.

Electric 40 listed height: 45 kW, 21 m³/.zh: 电动40目录高度：45 kW、21 m³/h，两列骨料
Electric 40 listed height: 45 kW, 21 m³/.pt: Electric 40 listed height: 45 kW, 21 m³/h, two agregado columns
Electric 40 listed height: 45 kW, 21 m³/.ar: Electric 40 listed height: 45 kW, 21 m³/h, two ركام columns
Electric 40 listed height: 45 kW, 21 m³/.ru: Electric 40 listed height: 45 kW, 21 m³/h, two заполнитель columns

The Electric 40 concrete pump we build i.zh: 我们在邢台制造的电动40型混凝土泵，目录为 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³。细石输送公布为水平 120 m / 垂直 360 m。13 mm 骨料一列为水平 40 m / 垂直 120 m。整机 2300 kg，外形 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm，液压泵为川崎 112。电机功率、料斗容积和输送量都写在产品页上，和现场层数没有自动换算关系。这些是目录数字，不是我们在声称某座已完工的塔楼。
The Electric 40 concrete pump we build i.pt: The Electric 40 concrete pump we build in Xingtai is listed at 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and a 0.4 m³ hopper. Fine-stone conveying is published as 120 m horizontal / 360 m vertical. The 13 mm agregado column is 40 m horizontal / 120 m vertical. Main-unit weight is 2300 kg at 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm, with a Kawasaki 112 hydraulic pump. Those are catalogue numbers, not a completed tower we are claiming.
The Electric 40 concrete pump we build i.ar: The Electric 40 concrete pump we build in شينغتاي is listed at 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and a 0.4 m³ hopper. Fine-stone conveying is published as 120 m أفقي / 360 m عمودي. The 13 mm ركام column is 40 m أفقي / 120 m عمودي. Main-unit weight is 2300 kg at 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm, with a Kawasaki 112 hydraulic pump. Those are catalogue numbers, not a completed tower we are claiming.
The Electric 40 concrete pump we build i.ru: The Electric 40 concrete pump we build in Синтай is listed at 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and a 0.4 m³ hopper. Fine-stone conveying is published as 120 m горизонталь / 360 m вертикаль. The 13 mm заполнитель column is 40 m горизонталь / 120 m вертикаль. Main-unit weight is 2300 kg at 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm, with a Kawasaki 112 hydraulic pump. Those are catalogue numbers, not a completed tower we are claiming.

Read the 13 mm column against a 60 m ris.zh: 用 60 m 立管去读 13 mm 这一列，要老实：目录垂直泵送高度 120 m 高于 60 m，但水平只有 40 m。地面管一长，这 40 m 可能在管子拐上楼之前就用完。细石 120 m / 360 m 看起来宽裕，前提是料真是细石。读 45 kW 电机也以现场有稳定三相电为前提。电动40是我们给供电稳定的中型建筑做对照的起点，不是所有高层的统一答案。
Read the 13 mm column against a 60 m ris.pt: Read the 13 mm column against a 60 m riser with honest eyes. The listed vertical pumping height of 120 m sits above 60 m, but the listed horizontal is only 40 m. A long ground line can close that 40 m before the pipe ever turns up the building. Fine-stone 120 m / 360 m looks roomier; it only applies if the mix is actually pedra fina. We use Electric 40 as a starting comparison for medium buildings with stable trifásico power, not as a universal high-rise answer.
Read the 13 mm column against a 60 m ris.ar: Read the 13 mm column against a 60 m riser with honest eyes. The listed عمودي pumping height of 120 m sits above 60 m, but the listed أفقي is only 40 m. A long ground line can close that 40 m before the pipe ever turns up the building. Fine-stone 120 m / 360 m looks roomier; it only applies if the mix is actually حصى ناعم. We use Electric 40 as a starting comparison for medium buildings with stable ثلاثي الطور power, not as a universal high-rise answer.
Read the 13 mm column against a 60 m ris.ru: Read the 13 mm column against a 60 m riser with honest eyes. The listed вертикаль pumping height of 120 m sits above 60 m, but the listed горизонталь is only 40 m. A long ground line can close that 40 m before the pipe ever turns up the building. Fine-stone 120 m / 360 m looks roomier; it only applies if the mix is actually мелкий камень. We use Electric 40 as a starting comparison for medium buildings with stable трёхфазный power, not as a universal high-rise answer.

Electric 60 listed height: 90 kW, 40 m³/.zh: 电动60目录高度：90 kW、40 m³/h，三种石子
Electric 60 listed height: 90 kW, 40 m³/.pt: Electric 60 listed height: 90 kW, 40 m³/h, three stone sizes
Electric 60 listed height: 90 kW, 40 m³/.ar: Electric 60 listed height: 90 kW, 40 m³/h, three stone sizes
Electric 60 listed height: 90 kW, 40 m³/.ru: Electric 60 listed height: 90 kW, 40 m³/h, three stone sizes

The Electric 60 concrete pump is listed.zh: 电动60型混凝土泵目录为 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³。细石、13 mm、24 mm 三行要分开读：细石水平 200 m / 垂直 600 m，13 mm 石子 150 m / 450 m，24 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m。不能拿细石行去套 24 mm 浇筑，也不能用 600 m 去理解 20 层现场。外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm，整机 3300 kg，液压为川崎双 112。输送量从电动40的 21 m³/h 到这里的 40 m³/h，楼层浇筑窗口短的时候这个差有意义。
The Electric 60 concrete pump is listed.pt: The Electric 60 concrete pump is listed at 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and a 0.7 m³ hopper. Fine stone is 200 m horizontal / 600 m vertical. 13 mm stone is 150 m / 450 m. 24 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. The frame is 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm at 3300 kg, with a Kawasaki double 112 pump. Output moves from 21 m³/h on Electric 40 to 40 m³/h here, which matters when the pour window on a floor is short.
The Electric 60 concrete pump is listed.ar: The Electric 60 concrete pump is listed at 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and a 0.7 m³ hopper. Fine stone is 200 m أفقي / 600 m عمودي. 13 mm stone is 150 m / 450 m. 24 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. The frame is 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm at 3300 kg, with a Kawasaki double 112 pump. Output moves from 21 m³/h on Electric 40 to 40 m³/h here, which matters when the pour window on a floor is short.
The Electric 60 concrete pump is listed.ru: The Electric 60 concrete pump is listed at 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and a 0.7 m³ hopper. Fine stone is 200 m горизонталь / 600 m вертикаль. 13 mm stone is 150 m / 450 m. 24 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. The frame is 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm at 3300 kg, with a Kawasaki double 112 pump. Output moves from 21 m³/h on Electric 40 to 40 m³/h here, which matters when the pour window on a floor is short.

If your mix is closer to 24 mm, the publ.zh: 若配合比更接近 24 mm，拿来对照 60 m 升高的目录垂直泵送高度是 300 m，水平列为 100 m。机重 3300 kg 和双 112 泵说明这是更大一档拖式泵，不是某工地的实测记录。这仍是目录包络，不是保证任何 20 层布置都能打到 40 m³/h。我们会同时要坍落度和最大骨料，避免搅拌站在供 24 mm 石子时我们却去读细石那一行。
If your mix is closer to 24 mm, the publ.pt: If your mix is closer to 24 mm, the published vertical pumping height to compare with that 60 m rise is 300 m, with 100 m listed horizontally. That is still a catalogue envelope, not a promise that any 20-floor layout will run at 40 m³/h. We ask for slump and maximum agregado together so we do not read the pedra fina row when the batch plant is feeding 24 mm stone.
If your mix is closer to 24 mm, the publ.ar: If your mix is closer to 24 mm, the published عمودي pumping height to compare with that 60 m rise is 300 m, with 100 m listed أفقيly. That is still a catalogue envelope, not a promise that any 20-floor layout will run at 40 m³/h. We ask for slump and maximum ركام together so we do not read the حصى ناعم row when the batch plant is feeding 24 mm stone.
If your mix is closer to 24 mm, the publ.ru: If your mix is closer to 24 mm, the published вертикаль pumping height to compare with that 60 m rise is 300 m, with 100 m listed горизонтальly. That is still a catalogue envelope, not a promise that any 20-floor layout will run at 40 m³/h. We ask for slump and maximum заполнитель together so we do not read the мелкий камень row when the batch plant is feeding 24 mm stone.

Electric 80 listed height: HBT80-1816-11.zh: 电动80目录高度：HBT80-1816-110，垂直 300 m
Electric 80 listed height: HBT80-1816-11.pt: Electric 80 listed height: HBT80-1816-110 at 300 m vertical
Electric 80 listed height: HBT80-1816-11.ar: Electric 80 listed height: HBT80-1816-110 at 300 m عمودي
Electric 80 listed height: HBT80-1816-11.ru: Electric 80 listed height: HBT80-1816-110 at 300 m вертикаль

Buyers searching for an electric 80 conc.zh: 检索电动80型混凝土泵的采购方，通常是想同时保住垂直泵送高度和小时输送量。我们的电动80目录型号为 HBT80-1816-110：110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³，2 cm 骨料下水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m，川崎 140 双泵，外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm，整机 6000 kg。这一档把垂直 300 m 和 60 m³/h 写在同一张表上。石子落在约 2 cm 这一档时，我们把目录垂直 300 m 放到高层立管旁边对照。
Buyers searching for an electric 80 conc.pt: Buyers searching for an electric 80 concrete pump are usually trying to protect vertical pumping height and hourly output together. Our Electric 80 is listed as HBT80-1816-110: 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 0.7 m³ hopper, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical at 2 cm agregado, Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm, 6000 kg. The 300 m vertical figure is the catalogue number we put next to a high-rise riser when the stone is in that 2 cm class.
Buyers searching for an electric 80 conc.ar: Buyers searching for an electric 80 concrete pump are usually trying to protect عمودي pumping height and hourly output together. Our Electric 80 is listed as HBT80-1816-110: 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 0.7 m³ hopper, 900 m أفقي / 300 m عمودي at 2 cm ركام, Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm, 6000 kg. The 300 m عمودي figure is the catalogue number we put next to a high-rise riser when the stone is in that 2 cm class.
Buyers searching for an electric 80 conc.ru: Buyers searching for an electric 80 concrete pump are usually trying to protect вертикаль pumping height and hourly output together. Our Electric 80 is listed as HBT80-1816-110: 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 0.7 m³ hopper, 900 m горизонталь / 300 m вертикаль at 2 cm заполнитель, Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm, 6000 kg. The 300 m вертикаль figure is the catalogue number we put next to a high-rise riser when the stone is in that 2 cm class.

60 m³/h is the listed theoretical output.zh: 60 m³/h 是目录理论输送量，高于电动60的 40 m³/h，也明显高于电动40的 21 m³/h。要在冷缝出现前铺完一层时，这一列可以和 300 m 高度同样重要。电机 110 kW，现场仍需撑得住这台电机的三相电源；询价时请写清变压器或发电机能否带该电机。我们在邢台制造的是这台拖式泵，不会在同一页上把它写成车载臂架。
60 m³/h is the listed theoretical output.pt: 60 m³/h is the listed saída teórica, twice Electric 60’s 40 m³/h and well above Electric 40’s 21 m³/h. For a building pour that has to cover a floor before a cold joint, that column can matter as much as the 300 m height. Power demand is 110 kW, so the site still needs a trifásico supply that can hold that motor. We manufacture this bomba reboque in Xingtai; we do not turn it into a truck-mounted boom on the same page.
60 m³/h is the listed theoretical output.ar: 60 m³/h is the listed الإنتاج النظري, twice Electric 60’s 40 m³/h and well above Electric 40’s 21 m³/h. For a building pour that has to cover a floor before a cold joint, that column can matter as much as the 300 m height. Power demand is 110 kW, so the site still needs a ثلاثي الطور supply that can hold that motor. We manufacture this مضخة مقطورة in شينغتاي; we do not turn it into a truck-mounted boom on the same page.

Power demand is 110 kW, so the site still needs a трёхфазный supply that can hold that motor. We manufacture this прицепной насос in Синтай; we do not turn it into a truck-mounted boom on the same page.

We sell pipeline trailer pumps, not truc.pt: We sell pipeline bomba reboques, not truck-mounted placing booms

Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Renze Industri.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台任泽工业园区公布的是电动拖式泵、柴油拖式泵和搅拌泵。我们不销售车载布料杆，目录里也没有臂架泵。若图纸要的是底盘上 30 m 或 50 m 布料杆，那是另一类设备。我们的高层答案是从泵料斗到楼面的固定或拖式管路，按上面的目录水平/垂直表来对照。
Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Renze Industri.pt: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai, publishes electric bomba reboques, diesel bomba reboques and bomba misturadoras. We do not sell truck-mounted placing booms, and we do not list a bomba lança in the catalogue. If a drawing calls for a 30 m or 50 m boom on a chassis, that is a different machine family. Our high-rise answer is a stationary or trailer pipeline from the pump hopper to the floor, sized against the listed H / V tables above.
Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Renze Industri.ar: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Renze Industrial Park, شينغتاي, publishes electric مضخة مقطورةs, diesel مضخة مقطورةs and مضخة خلاطs. We do not sell truck-mounted placing booms, and we do not list a مضخة ذراع in the catalogue. If a drawing calls for a 30 m or 50 m boom on a chassis, that is a different machine family. Our high-rise answer is a stationary or trailer pipeline from the pump hopper to the floor, sized against the listed H / V tables above.
Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Renze Industri.ru: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Renze Industrial Park, Синтай, publishes electric прицепной насосs, diesel прицепной насосs and бетононасос-миксерs. We do not sell truck-mounted placing booms, and we do not list a автобетононасос со стрелой in the catalogue. If a drawing calls for a 30 m or 50 m boom on a chassis, that is a different machine family. Our high-rise answer is a stationary or trailer pipeline from the pump hopper to the floor, sized against the listed H / V tables above.

We also do not manufacture mixing plants.zh: 搅拌站和喷涂机也不是我们的目录产品。建筑项目请从电动泵枢纽页和建筑施工方案页入手，再打开选型指南，把层高、管路布置和骨料写清楚。选型指南把高层/中型/小型目录型号并列，便于把 60 m 立管放到电动40、60、80 之间比较。询价里有这三项，我们的工程师就可以对照这三台泵，不必往参数表里添数字。
We also do not manufacture mixing plants.pt: We also do not manufacture mixing plants as catalogue products. Spraying machines are listed separately. For building work, start on the electric hub and the construction solutions page, then use the product selection guide with floor height, pipe plan and agregado written down. When those three numbers are on the inquiry, our engineers can compare Electric 40, Electric 60 and Electric 80 without padding the table.
We also do not manufacture mixing plants.ar: We also do not manufacture mixing plants as catalogue products. Spraying machines are listed separately. Does 20 floors always mean the Electric.zh: 20 层是不是一定选电动40就够？
Does 20 floors always mean the Electric.pt: Does 20 floors always mean the Electric 40 is enough?
Does 20 floors always mean the Electric.ar: Does 20 floors always mean the Electric 40 is enough?
Does 20 floors always mean the Electric.ru: Does 20 floors always mean the Electric 40 is enough?

No. 20 floors × about 3 m is only ≈ 60 m.zh: 不是。20 层 × 约 3 m 只是约 60 m 垂直升高。电动40在 13 mm 骨料下列垂直 120 m，但同一行水平只有 40 m，地面管一长就会先碰到水平列。地面管长、24 mm 石子或浇筑窗口短，对照就会转到电动60（24 mm：100 m / 300 m，40 m³/h）或电动80（2 cm 骨料 900 m / 300 m，60 m³/h）。
No. 20 floors × about 3 m is only ≈ 60 m.pt: No. 20 floors × about 3 m is only ≈ 60 m of vertical rise. Electric 40 lists 120 m vertical on 13 mm agregado, but only 40 m horizontal on that same row. Long ground pipe, 24 mm stone, or a short pour window can push the comparison to Electric 60 (24 mm: 100 m / 300 m) or the Electric 80 (900 m / 300 m at 2 cm agregado, 60 m³/h).
No. 20 floors × about 3 m is only ≈ 60 m.ar: No. 20 floors × about 3 m is only ≈ 60 m of عمودي rise. Electric 40 lists 120 m عمودي on 13 mm ركام, but only 40 m أفقي on that same row. Long ground pipe, 24 mm stone, or a short pour window can push the comparison to Electric 60 (24 mm: 100 m / 300 m) or the Electric 80 (900 m / 300 m at 2 cm ركام, 60 m³/h).
No. 20 floors × about 3 m is only ≈ 60 m.ru: No. 20 floors × about 3 m is only ≈ 60 m of вертикаль rise. Electric 40 lists 120 m вертикаль on 13 mm заполнитель, but only 40 m горизонталь on that same row. Long ground pipe, 24 mm stone, or a short pour window can push the comparison to Electric 60 (24 mm: 100 m / 300 m) or the Electric 80 (900 m / 300 m at 2 cm заполнитель, 60 m³/h).

Why do you ask for ground-pipe length as.zh: 为什么除了层数还要问地面管长度？
Why do you ask for ground-pipe length as.pt: Why do you ask for ground-pipe length as well as floor count?
Why do you ask for ground-pipe length as.ar: Why do you ask for ground-pipe length as well as floor count?
Why do you ask for ground-pipe length as.ru: Why do you ask for ground-pipe length as well as floor count?

Catalogue vertical pumping height is one.zh: 目录垂直泵送高度是一列，水平距离是另一列。高层建筑两列都用得到：地面管、立管、再楼面管。除已公布的米数外，我们不再另发换算比。量出水平段，才不会把整列垂直高度都花在楼层上，却忘了地上还要铺管。
Catalogue vertical pumping height is one.pt: Catalogue vertical pumping height is one column. Horizontal distance is another. A high-rise building uses both: ground line, riser, then deck line. We do not publish an extra conversion ratio beyond those listed metres. Measuring the horizontal run keeps us from spending the whole vertical column on floors that still need pipe on the ground.
Catalogue vertical pumping height is one.ar: Catalogue عمودي pumping height is one column. Horizontal distance is another. A high-rise building uses both: ground line, riser, then deck line. We do not publish an extra conversion ratio beyond those listed metres. Measuring the أفقي run keeps us from spending the whole عمودي column on floors that still need pipe on the ground.
Catalogue vertical pumping height is one.ru: Catalogue вертикаль pumping height is one column. Horizontal distance is another. A high-rise building uses both: ground line, riser, then deck line. We do not publish an extra conversion ratio beyond those listed metres. Measuring the горизонталь run keeps us from spending the whole вертикаль column on floors that still need pipe on the ground.

Do you sell truck-mounted placing booms.zh: 高层施工你们卖车载布料杆吗？
Do you sell truck-mounted placing booms.pt: Do you sell truck-mounted placing booms for high-rise work?
Do you sell truck-mounted placing booms.ar: Do you sell truck-mounted placing booms for high-rise work?

Buyers writing to our Xingtai plant ofte.zh: 采购方写信到我们邢台任泽工业园区工厂时，第一个问题常常一样：你们电动低压40出口压力是20 MPa，是不是一台更弱的40？我们工程师的回答很明确：不是。这台泵目录里的“低压”，是针对细石拌合物和管路距离做的调校，不是把液压系统减配。我们把它和电动30、电动40放在同一档讨论，只因为三者都是有电网的拖式泵送，并不能互相替代，也不能靠型号里的数字去猜。
Buyers writing to our Xingtai plant ofte.pt: Buyers writing to our Xingtai plant often ask: your Electric Low Pressure 40 sits at 20 MPa — is that a weaker 40? Our engineers say no. Low pressure here is a mix and distance choice, not a downgrade. The three electric trailers share a job family, but they are not interchangeable.
Buyers writing to our Xingtai plant ofte.ar: Buyers writing to our شينغتاي plant often ask: your Electric Low Pressure 40 sits at 20 MPa — is that a weaker 40? Our engineers say no. Buyers writing to our Xingtai plant ofte.ru: Buyers writing to our Синтай plant often ask: your Electric Low Pressure 40 sits at 20 MPa — is that a weaker 40? Our engineers say no. A catalogue name with “low pressure” is.zh: 目录名称里带“低压”，很容易被读成功率不够、压力不够。在我们车间里，这句话只表示按细石混凝土调校，而不是为了省成本砍掉液压件。川崎112液压泵与标准电动40同属一系。拖泵外形与电动30同为3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、整机同样1200 kg。真正变化的是电机功率、目录输送量，以及已公布的细石水平/垂直输送距离表。采购时请对这三行，而不是对“40”这个称呼。
A catalogue name with “low pressure” is.pt: A catalogue name with “low pressure” is easy to misread. On our floor it means we tuned the unit for pedra fina concrete, not that we cut the hydraulic package. Kawasaki 112 is the same family we fit on Electric 40. The trailer shares the 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm envelope with Electric 30. Motor, output, and the pedra fina table are what change.

The Electric Low Pressure 40 on /product.zh: 产品页 /products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump 上的电动低压40，是一台37 kW电动拖泵。目录输送量12–15 m³/h，出口压力20 MPa，料斗0.3 m³，细石水平80 m、垂直240 m，整机1200 kg，液压泵为川崎112。这些是我们愿意对表的数字。我们不会再另加未公布的“工作压力”栏，也不会把细石距离说成普通骨料距离。

Those figures sit between two neighbours.zh: 这组参数夹在两台邻机之间，选型时必须三台一起看。电动30（/products/electric-30-concrete-pump）是30 kW电机，同样12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、0.3 m³料斗，同样1200 kg、3300 mm级外形，但细石表只有60 m / 180 m。标准电动40（/products/electric-40-concrete-pump）升到45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、0.4 m³料斗、细石120 m / 360 m，整机2300 kg，外形3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。低压40既不是30的贴纸改款，也不是40的缩水版。

Buyers pouring fine-stone screeds, secon.zh: 做细石楼面、二次结构、室内管路的采购方，真正要看的是细石那一行，而不是型号里的数字。如果拌合物仍在细石范围内，管路又长过电动30的60 m水平 / 180 m垂直，但仍落在80 m / 240 m以内，我们会先谈低压40。这是细石泵的选择，不是“更大号40”的选择。工地若把低压40当成标准电动40来下料速度，会发现目录输送量并没有变成21 m³/h。
Buyers pouring fine-stone screeds, secon.pt: Buyers pouring pedra fina screeds, secondary structure, and indoor pipeline work should read the pedra fina row, not the model number. If the mix stays pedra fina and the run is longer than Electric 30 (60 m / 180 m) but still inside 80 m / 240 m, we discuss Low Pressure 40 first.
Buyers pouring fine-stone screeds, secon.ar: Buyers pouring حصى ناعم screeds, secondary structure, and indoor pipeline work should read the حصى ناعم row, not the model number. If the mix stays حصى ناعم and the run is longer than Electric 30 (60 m / 180 m) but still inside 80 m / 240 m, we discuss Low Pressure 40 first.
Buyers pouring fine-stone screeds, secon.ru: Buyers pouring мелкий камень screeds, secondary structure, and indoor pipeline work should read the мелкий камень row, not the model number. If the mix stays мелкий камень and the run is longer than Electric 30 (60 m / 180 m) but still inside 80 m / 240 m, we discuss Low Pressure 40 first.

If you need 21 m³/h or the 23 MPa / 120.zh: 如果需要21 m³/h，或23 MPa、细石120 m / 360 m那一行，那就是标准电动40。多出来的1100 kg和3900 mm机身是这一档必须接受的部分。我们不会说低压40“差不多够到”。它够不到。目录输送量仍是12–15 m³/h，目录压力仍是20 MPa。细石泵不是把40的压力改低一点那么简单，车体、料斗、电机都要一起对表。
If you need 21 m³/h or the 23 MPa / 120.pt: If you need 21 m³/h or the 23 MPa / 120 m / 360 m pedra fina table, that is Electric 40. The extra 1100 kg and 3900 mm frame are part of that step. We will not say Low Pressure 40 almost reaches those numbers. Output stays 12–15 m³/h and pressure stays 20 MPa.
If you need 21 m³/h or the 23 MPa / 120.ar: If you need 21 m³/h or the 23 MPa / 120 m / 360 m حصى ناعم table, that is Electric 40. The extra 1100 kg and 3900 mm frame are part of that step. We will not say Low Pressure 40 almost reaches those numbers. Output stays 12–15 m³/h and pressure stays 20 MPa.
If you need 21 m³/h or the 23 MPa / 120.ru: If you need 21 m³/h or the 23 MPa / 120 m / 360 m мелкий камень table, that is Electric 40. The extra 1100 kg and 3900 mm frame are part of that step. We will not say Low Pressure 40 almost reaches those numbers. Output stays 12–15 m³/h and pressure stays 20 MPa.

Weight and footprint decide whether a pu.pt: Weight and footprint decide whether a pump fits a small hoist or a narrow yard. Low Pressure 40 and Electric 30 share 1200 kg and 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. The 37 kW motor is why Low Pressure 40 e.zh: 单独做低压40这个型号，是因为37 kW电机，不是电动30换了贴纸。装配线上把川崎112和37 kW电机装进30级底盘，细石表才能从60 m / 180 m走到80 m / 240 m，而不必跳到2300 kg那一档。这就是电动40低压在系列里的位置：电机比30大，车体同级，仍不是45 kW、21 m³/h的电动40。采购方若只要更大输送量，请直接看电动40，不要在低压40上找21 m³/h。
The 37 kW motor is why Low Pressure 40 e.pt: The 37 kW motor is why Low Pressure 40 exists as its own SKU. It is not a sticker change on Electric 30. We fit Kawasaki 112 and the 37 kW motor into the 30-class chassis so the pedra fina table can move from 60 / 180 m to 80 / 240 m without jumping to 2300 kg. That is the electric 40 low pressure position: more motor than the 30, same size class, still not the 45 kW Electric 40.

A mixing plant sits on a yard. It batche.pt: A mixing plant sits on a yard. It batches cement, sand, stone and water, then loads mixer trucks. It does not travel to a house site and it does not push concrete through pipe. If you need a plant, you need a different factory.

When a crew is pouring a two-storey hous.zh: 村里巷道尽头浇两层自建房时，我们听到的第一句往往不是“多少兆帕”，而是家里那台拖拉机能不能把泵拖进去。三相电经常没有，机耕路也容不下两吨级拖泵。车载臂架泵不在我们的目录里。拖拉机带动4100就是按这个工况、在邢台任泽工业园区做出来的农村施工泵：目录功率40 kW、整机1300 kg、外形2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm，给已经有农用拖拉机的自建房和小型二次结构用。
When a crew is pouring a two-storey hous.pt: When a crew is pouring a two-storey house at the end of a village lane, the first question we hear is not “how many MPa”. It is whether the tractor they already own can tow the pump in. Grid power is often missing. A truck-mounted bomba lança is not in our catalogue. That is the job we designed the Tractor-Driven 4100 around: a rural construction pump listed at 40 kW, 1300 kg, and 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm.

We manufacture the 4100 concrete pump in.zh: 4100混凝土泵由河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造。我们的工程师把拖拉机带动当成进场条件，而不是口号：先看巷道、院门和垫木，再看管路。只要拖拉机能把泵拖到料斗位置、管路又落在目录距离内，这台机通常是我们三台农村柴油选项里的中间档——比17 kW紧凑机更能打二层和稍长的管，又不必上柴油30那种工地拖泵。产品页在 /products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump。
We manufacture the 4100 concrete pump in.pt: We manufacture the 4100 concrete pump in Xingtai, Hebei, at Hebei Pinjin Machinery. Our engineers treat tractor drive as a site-access decision, not a marketing slogan. If the tractor can reach the hopper position and the pipeline stays inside the published distances, this model is usually the middle of our three rural diesel options—not the lightest, and not the long-distance trailer.

A tractor concrete pump is still a trail.zh: 拖拉机混凝土泵本质仍是拖式泵送主机。拖拉机负责把泵带进村路，并在这台机上提供我们标定的40 kW驱动。所以工地本来就有农用拖拉机的班组，会问4100，而不是再拖一台过不了院门的自带柴油机组。
A tractor concrete pump is still a trail.pt: A tractor concrete pump is still a trailer-style pumping unit. The tractor is the prime mover that takes it down a village road and, on this model, supplies the drive we rate at 40 kW. That is why crews who already keep a farm tractor on site ask for the 4100 instead of a self-powered diesel skid they cannot squeeze through a courtyard gate.

Look at the width first. We list 1000 mm.zh: 先看宽度。我们列的是1000 mm。农村柴油紧凑泵宽1100 mm，柴油30是1500 mm。两道院墙之间的土路上，比紧凑泵再窄100 mm往往不是决定因素；1500 mm对1000 mm才是停在搅拌机旁边、还是把泵撂在村外大路上的差别。长度2900 mm，不是我们最短的机——农村柴油紧凑泵是2200 mm——但比柴油30的4000 mm短一截，转弯和院门口更容易过。
Look at the width first. We list 1000 mm.pt: Look at the width first. We list 1000 mm. The compact rural diesel pump is 1100 mm wide; Diesel 30 is 1500 mm. On a packed-earth lane between two courtyard walls, 1500 mm versus 1000 mm is the difference between parking beside the mixer and leaving the pump on the main road. Length is 2900 mm, so it is not the shortest machine we build—the rural diesel compact is 2200 mm—but it is still far shorter than Diesel 30 at 4000 mm.

Weight follows the same story. 1300 kg i.zh: 重量也是同一条线。1300 kg比农村柴油紧凑泵的800 kg重，比柴油30拖泵的2000 kg轻。我们的工程师会问：拖拉机挂钩、车辙和房边垫木能不能吃住1.3吨再加满料斗。不行就指向更轻的农村柴油泵。行，而且管路仍短，通常不必升到工地级拖泵，4100就够。
Weight follows the same story. 1300 kg i.pt: Weight follows the same story. 1300 kg is heavier than the 800 kg rural diesel compact, and lighter than the 2000 kg Diesel 30 trailer. Our engineers ask whether the tractor hitch, the ruts, and the house-side pad can take 1.3 tonnes plus a full hopper. If the answer is no, we point to the lighter rural diesel pump. If the answer is yes and the pipeline is still short, the 4100 is usually enough without stepping up to a construction-site trailer.
